driverRegime.method: daily % change of each asset regressed on the daily change in the US 2-year and 10-year yields (basis points) and on the daily % change in WTI; a driver is dominant when |corr| >= 0.4

dataNotes: Run timing: this cycle ran the morning of 9 October 2026 after the GitHub Actions pre-open fetch job drafted contracts/*.2026-10-08.json from Thursday 8 October's close. Every figure used is dated at or before the 2026-10-08 close; nothing dated 9 October (including the live.json morning prices) was used.

Bonds, dollar and IWM sigma are not auto-fetched and were carried stale: bonds 15 (TLT 30-day implied volatility, 25 September), dollar 4.72 (EUR/USD 1-month implied volatility, 21 September), IWM 19.97 (RVX, 23 September). No newer prints were obtained; no web search for fresh volatility prints was run.

Source notes: the news log gives cash S&P 500 7,765.36 (-0.47%), Dow 51,231.64 (+0.10%), Nasdaq Composite 27,193.34 (-1.25%), 10-year yield about 5.23% and 30-year about 5.67% on 8 October; the drafted ES=F/NQ=F/RTY=F/GC=F/ZN=F/DX-Y.NYB closes are used for all numbers (futures settle later than the 4pm cash close, so percentage moves differ from cash). WTI about $91 and Brent above $103 are from the 8 October close entry.

No 8 October high-yield OAS, MOVE, breadth counts, positioning print or seasonal statistic was obtainable; credit, breadth, positioning, sentiment and seasonality votes are neutral. AAII (week to 23 September) is the newest obtainable survey. No scheduled 8 October macro release is in the news log, so macro calendar is neutral.

Fed: September FOMC minutes (released 7 October) said most participants saw a further hike 'likely appropriate by year end'; October hike odds about 17-20% and fed funds 3.75%-4.00% are from the 7 October news-log entries, the latest Fed information in the log.

News-log entries for 2026-10-08 (five entries: Hormuz tanker attacks, Asia lower, OpenAI/chip selloff, US close, PepsiCo) were already in data/news_log.json and matched the Artifact database; no merge was needed. No hand-entered issue entries were dated 8 October.

newsLog.event: Asian stocks track Wall Street lower as soaring Treasury yields and hawkish Fed minutes (more tightening signaled) weigh

newsLog.numbers: Nasdaq 27,193.34 (-345.35, -1.25%); Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell as much as 4% intraday; Arm, Intel, Marvell each -6%+; Nvidia, Micron also lower
newsLog.reaction: Broad tech-led selloff; renewed doubts about AI capex/revenue sustainability
newsLog.tickers: QQQ, Nasdaq, NVDA, MU, INTC, ARM, MRVL, SOXX

newsLog.event: US stocks close mixed: Dow ekes out a gain while S&P 500 and Nasdaq slip as the chip/AI selloff offsets strength elsewhere; 10-year Treasury yield eases slightly but holds near multidecade highs
newsLog.reaction: Risk-off in tech/semis, defensive Dow components outperform; Bitcoin -2% to ~$81K with ~$974M in crypto liquidations; oil firm (WTI ~$91, Brent >$103) on Iran/Hormuz tensions
